body.name: Warlord's Armor Shard
body.description: A shard from the legendary Warlord's battle-worn armor, a relic echoing ancient conflicts. Each fragment bears the weight of innumerable battles.

body.name: Warlord's Broken Sword Blade
body.description: The legendary Warlord's riven weapon, shattered in the crucible of battle. A silent testament to the unwavering determination of its former master.

body.name: Wendigo's Hoof
body.description: These are the hooves of a sturdy Wendigo as he trod the cold earth.

body.name: Wendigo's Sharp Claws
body.description: These are the nails of Wendigo, who has slaughtered countless creatures, tearing their flesh apart.

body.name: Wendigo's Antler Fragment
body.description: Wendigo's grotesquely overgrown horns bear the dried blood of countless victims.

body.name: Wendigo's Entrails
body.description: Wendigo's guts, grotesquely exposed outside his body, reek of decay, deterioration, death, and contamination.

body.name: White Sash
body.description: A pristine white sash, radiating an air of elegance and purity.

body.name: White Shark Fin
body.description: The dorsal fin of the great white shark, known as the outlaw of the sea. Thick and tough in texture, it is regarded among gourmets as a rare delicacy.

body.name: White Shark Hide
body.description: The dorsal hide of a great white shark, surprisingly smooth and soft despite its ferocious owner. Its surface still holds traces of seawater, giving it a faint, lingering dampness.

body.name: White Shark Tooth
body.description: A razor-sharp tooth made for rending flesh, its surface still crusted with the flesh and fresh blood of a recently bitten prey.

body.name: White Thread Spool
body.description: A bundle of white thread neatly wound around a wooden spool.
